gates.title: Stand up offline encrypted vault & check Nov 30, 2026 Decline-in-Value deadline
gates.required_evidence: Access-controlled offline folder (never Git); current LA County secured tax bill vs estimated market value before Nov 30, 2026 DIV deadline.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: PII leak if placed in public Git; missed 2026-2027 property tax reduction window if assessed value exceeds market value.

gates.title: Commission private lease abstract & reconcile option notice calendar
gates.required_evidence: Executed base lease, all amendments, assignments, commencement letter; exact expiry date (within 2030–2035), option notice open/close dates, rent bumps, ROFR, and Prop 13 tax pass-through clause.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Soliciting buyers over an active ROFR or missing an option/notice window destroys negotiating leverage irreversibly.

gates.title: Verify tenant-of-record, guarantor net worth & unit gross sales / rent-to-sales ratio
gates.required_evidence: 3-year store gross sales statements (if lease requires reporting), guarantor financials, and confirmation whether store is on or immune from 'JACK on Track' closure list.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: System franchise SSS fell -7.0% in Q1 FY2026 with 50–100 closures guided; assuming automatic renewal without unit health is blind speculation.

gates.title: Fix private 1-mile & 3-mile Census tract ring, ZIMAS zoning & frontage AADT
gates.cost_time: $0 (free Census API key + ZIMAS + LADOT/Caltrans) · 2–3 days
gates.required_evidence: Exact parcel tract + 1-mi/3-mi ring tracts; multi-vintage ACS income/population trend, LEHD daytime workers, feeder school enrollment, ZIMAS TOC/zoning, and arterial AADT.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: City of LA (3.81M pop, -0.9% YoY) and LA Metro averages misstate hyper-local QSR trade-area demand and land redevelopment floor.

gates.title: Screen parcel-level seismic, flood, fire zones, building vintage, Phase I ESA & insurance
gates.cost_time: $0 map screen; $2,500–$6,000 if Phase I ESA / PML needed · 2–3 weeks
gates.required_evidence: FEMA NFHL FIRMette, CGS EQ ZApp fault/liquefaction check, CAL FIRE LRA FHSZ check, loss-of-rent/earthquake/fire policy certificates, environmental history.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Unpriced liquefaction, pre-1994 structural vulnerability, historical auto/fuel contamination, or insurer non-renewal kills buyer financing in escrow.

gates.title: Reconstruct CPA tax basis, accumulated §1250 depreciation, debt payoff & ULA exposure
gates.required_evidence: Original cost/step-up basis, depreciation schedule (allowed/allowable), debt prepayment terms, passive loss carryovers, City of LA jurisdiction check for Measure ULA (>$5M).
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Combined federal (20% LTCG / 25% §1250 + 3.8% NIIT) + CA (up to 13.3%) + ULA taxes can consume 30%–42%+ of gross gain, flipping sell vs hold.

gates.title: Price short-lease discount from real written BOVs, comps & lender term sheets
gates.owner: 2–3 Net-Lease Brokers (under NDA) + Commercial Mortgage Broker
gates.required_evidence: 3 independent BOVs pricing PARCEL-001 'as-is' (short fuse) vs 'extended 10–15 yrs', backed by closed Southern California QSR NNN comps and 2 debt quotes.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Without real quotes, the cap-rate penalty as remaining lease term drops below 5–7 years is an unverified guess.

gates.title: Explore confidential 'blend-and-extend' / early renewal terms (if lease & ROFR permit)
gates.owner: Owner + Real Estate Counsel / Net-Lease Advisor
gates.required_evidence: Written term sheet or tenant response on early 10–15 yr extension, rent bump schedule, TI/remodel allowance request, and corporate/franchisee guaranty.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Cannot compare after-tax sale against a 'negotiated renewal case' until actual renewal rent and TI concessions are tested.

gates.title: Populate versioned sell-vs-hold model, run back-test & compound black-swan stress
gates.owner: Owner + Financial Advisor (using local browser calculator)
gates.required_evidence: After-tax net sale proceeds vs Risk-Adjusted Hold NPV, §1031 exchange alternative, and simultaneous earthquake/fire/vacancy stress survival check.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Selecting a winner on single-point base-case assumptions ignores tail risks that wipe out concentrated single-asset wealth.

gates.title: Evaluate owner portfolio concentration, liquidity need, estate horizon & §1031 appetite
gates.required_evidence: Share of owner net worth in PARCEL-001, income replacement target, step-up-in-basis horizon (IRC §1014), and willingness to manage re-leasing vs passive 1031 DST/NNN.
gates.breaks_if_skipped: Best decision for the property is not automatically the best risk-adjusted decision for the individual owner.
